title: Great set of partyware!
text: Great set of partyware!. This is a great party set. It has everything you need with cups, napkins and plates for a small get together or party. I actually have bought an additional set of these to just keep in my pantry in the random event I have people over I will be ready. Surprisingly, the plates are very sturdy and can hold up to wet/hot foods. The cups are ok (I mean, I tend to use larger solo cups if we are drinking cocktails) however, these are good for coffee or soft drinks. I also really love this green color. highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Havercamp Tennis Party for 16 Guests; Includes 16 ea. 7” Plates, Beverage Napkins and 12oz. Cups in Authentic Tennis Theme. Game, Set, Party
features: Honor the game they Love in a special way. Authentic, high resolution images of the ball, net and court bring the game and your party alive!
16 PLATES - 7 in. Plates, perfect for desserts, sides and appetizers. Sturdy Construction will hold up under all your delicious food. Close up image of the tennis ball in action.
16 NAPKINS – Beverage Napkins with vibrant graphics of tennis ball at net.

16 LG. CUPS - 12 oz. Paper Cups are great for hot or cold beverages. All paper party products exceed FDA standards, are biodegradable and a breeze to clean up! Great for Birthdays, Tournaments, Graduations and any Tennis Team Celebration.
